'''Tarlam''' was a small [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]]. [[City Hall]] was located in the center of the city, which was situated atop one of Makeb's seven-[[Kilometer/Legends|kilometer]]-high stone mesas, and [[Tarlam Estates Marketplace]] dominated the southern half of the city. [[Tarlam Central Square]] was located east of City Hall, and the northern district of the city was known as the [[Tarlam Oasis]].

==History==
Around [[3638 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|2.0}}</ref> the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Toborro]] unleashed one of his new [[Isotope-5 droid]]s on the city in order to convince [[Shalim Avesta]] to return control of [[the Ark]]. The city was also overrun by the forces of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] and [[InterStellar Regulators]]. By that time, Tarlam was run by [[Mayor/Legends|Mayor]] [[Erkens]], who was supported by Councilor [[Soler]] and other officials, though the mesa was in danger of collapsing because of the Hutt's deep-mining of Makeb's core. Tarlam had four shuttle pads; one in the southeast, one in the northwest, one in the Oasis, and one near the mayor's residence.
